lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in at least five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill structures, forming a semi-regular 2D lattice across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity; circular high-luminance blobs are centered on these intersections, forming an anchor-node grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature exhibiting a vertical luminance gradient—with lighter pixels on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge—extends from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance circular clusters localized primarily along the anterior margin and central surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, dark, fusiform object is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin, oriented parallel to the primary longitudinal axis of the subject.
